name: My Futa Valentine
source: Philip and Priya are unable to have children, due to Philip's low sperm count. After many unsuccessful treatments, they decided to try the Hermopolis Mothers Program in the Futanari Empire. What could go wrong...
translation: 由于菲利普精子数量过低，他与普莉娅，始终无法生育。多次治疗未果后，两人决定尝试扶她帝国的“赫尔莫波利斯母亲计划”。这能出什么岔子呢……
